quotes.text: I’m also proud that my amendments will improve the Department of Defense’s ability to respond during crises and ensure proper oversight of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Hearing about the teen girls targeted by nonconsensual AI-generated images, it's clear that action must be taken to protect them and all victims. The Take It Down Act is an important, bipartisan step forward. https://t.co/HYSlOodlZZ

Not even one week after Grok's antisemitic outburst, @DeptofDefense announced it will pay xAI $200 million to use the chatbot. Instead of rewarding Grok for spreading hate online, we should be using that money for something productive, like establishing guardrails for AI or building systems to combat online hate.

AI is everywhere and it's here for all of us. I was proud to join @NycAac to honor local students who've dedicated their time to teaching seniors in our community how to use AI safely. In a world where AI is always at our fingertips, everyone deserves to know how to use it, no matter their age.
